question.problem:
Let $F(x)=7x-4$ for $x\in [0,\pi ).$ Select the correct missing parts in the Fourier cosine series of the **even** $2\pi $-periodic extension $f(x)$ of the function $F(x)$ below.

$$
f(x)∼(-4+\frac{7\pi }{2})+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\,{{field-1}}\cdot {{field-2}}
$$
question.worked_solution:
For our Fourier cosine series, the coefficients are given by

$$
{a}_{n}=\frac{2}{\pi }{\int }_{0}^{\pi }f(x)\operatorname{cos}⁡(nx)\,\text{d}x.
$$

In our case, $f(x)=7x-4$ for $x\in (0,\pi ).$ So, substituting into the formula, we get

$$
{a}_{n}=\frac{2}{\pi }{\int }_{0}^{\pi }(7x-4)\operatorname{cos}⁡(nx)\,\text{d}x.
$$

We use the integration by parts: 

$$
\begin{aligned}u=7x-4\, & ⇒\,{u}^{′}=7 \\ {v}^{′}=\operatorname{cos}⁡(nx)\, & ⇒\,v=\frac{1}{n}\operatorname{sin}⁡(nx)\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & =\frac{2}{\pi }(uv\,{|}_{0}^{\pi }-{\int }_{0}^{\pi }v{u}^{′}\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{2}{\pi }(\frac{1}{n}[(7x-4)\operatorname{sin}⁡(nx)]_{0}^{\pi }-\frac{7}{n}{\int }_{0}^{\pi }\operatorname{sin}⁡(nx)\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{2}{n\pi }(((7\pi -4)\operatorname{sin}⁡(n\pi )+4\operatorname{sin}⁡(0))+\frac{7}{n}[\operatorname{cos}⁡(nx)]_{0}^{\pi }) \\  & =\frac{2}{n\pi }(0+\frac{7}{n}(\operatorname{cos}⁡(n\pi )-\operatorname{cos}⁡(0))) \\  & =\frac{14(\operatorname{cos}⁡(n\pi )-1)}{{n}^{2}\pi }.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, since $\operatorname{cos}⁡(n\pi )=(-1)^{n},$ we have

$$
{a}_{n}=\frac{14((-1)^{n}-1)}{\pi {n}^{2}}.
$$

Finally, the Fourier cosine series is

$$
f(x)∼(-4+\frac{7\pi }{2})+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{14((-1)^{n}-1)}{\pi {n}^{2}}\cdot \operatorname{cos}⁡(nx).
$$
